description: Lists a projects showcase's projects in order: slug, title, subtitle, a description excerpt, detail values by key, categories, and item counts. With project, it returns that project's full description, labeled details, and its photos and videos in order (ids, local paths, alt text). Use it to find a project's slug for upload_photos and update_project, or item ids for update_items, reorder_project_items, and covers. Paged: pass nextOffset as offset (20 projects or 50 items per page by default).

limit.description: Projects (or, with project, items) per page, up to 200, e.g. 50.

offset.description: nextOffset from a previous call, e.g. 20.

project.description: A project (slug, title, or id) to list with its items, e.g. "arched-entry-two-story".

showcaseId.description: Projects showcase id from list_showcases, e.g. "0190f5c2-7b1e-7c3a-9d2f-1a2b3c4d5e6f".

name: list_projects
title: List projects
